title: Starting to Exercise After Thirty
paragraphs: Pada usia tiga puluh empat, Rasha menyadari ia belum berolahraga teratur sejak kuliah, dan aktivitas sederhana seperti menaiki tangga mulai membuatnya lebih terengah-engah daripada yang nyaman ia akui.

Ia bergabung dengan gym setempat, merasa malu pada awalnya melihat anggota yang lebih muda menyelesaikan latihan yang ia rasa benar-benar sulit, kadang mempertimbangkan untuk berhenti setelah hanya beberapa sesi.

Seorang pelatih menyadari keraguannya dan meyakinkannya bahwa membandingkan bulan pertamanya dengan latihan konsisten orang lain selama bertahun-tahun tidaklah adil maupun berguna bagi kemajuannya sendiri.
Enam bulan kemudian, Rasha menyadari ia bisa menaiki tangga yang sama tanpa terengah-engah, perubahan kecil namun benar-benar bermakna yang memotivasinya untuk terus menjalankan rutinitas barunya.
answerKey: At thirty-four, Rasha realized she had not exercised regularly since university, and simple activities like climbing stairs had started leaving her more out of breath than she was comfortable admitting. She joined a local gym, feeling embarrassed at first watching younger members complete exercises she found genuinely difficult, occasionally considering quitting after only a few sessions. A trainer noticed her hesitation and reassured her that comparing her first month to someone else's years of consistent training was neither fair nor useful for her own progress. Six months later, Rasha noticed she could climb the same stairs without losing her breath, a small but genuinely meaningful change that motivated her to keep her new routine going.
